name: provider.schedule.reminder
description: Remind providers of their upcoming appointments and patient prep notes. Ensures providers are ready and patients feel cared for.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Fetch provider appointments for next 2 hours
steps.query: SELECT a.*, u.first_name as patient_first, u.last_name as patient_last, u.email as patient_email, p.first_name as provider_first, p.last_name as provider_last, p.email as provider_email FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.patient_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users p ON a.provider_id = p.id WHERE a.scheduled_at > NOW() AND a.scheduled_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours' AND a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')

steps.name: Send schedule summary to each provider
